description:
The `Initialize` and `ApplyProfile` materialization request variants flow through the shared plan-identity tail that the other request variants already reach.

## Background

The transaction kernel routes `MaterializationRequest` variants through a shared plan-identity tail, but two of them - `Initialize` and `ApplyProfile` - return early and never reach that tail. This task folds both variants into the shared tail so plan identity is derived uniformly for every request variant.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The `Initialize` and `ApplyProfile` request variants flow through the shared plan-identity tail rather than returning early.
- [hard] REQ-02: A test asserts that a plan identity is produced for all five `MaterializationRequest` variants (`SemanticMutation`, `RenderConfiguredProjections`, `RepairDerivedState`, `Initialize`, `ApplyProfile`).
- [hard] REQ-03: Existing behavior is preserved for every request variant; the materialization tests pass unchanged.

## Notes

If folding a variant into the shared tail proves genuinely impossible, that is resolved by a formal amendment to the plan, not by an in-task exemption.
title: Plan-identity tail for initialize and profile-application requests
